# Installation {#sec-installation}

This page describes how the project is installed on a local computer, and how
the documentation is built.

## Requirements {.unnumbered}

| Software | Version | Why it is needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | 3.12 or newer | The backend is written in Python. Qollab uses 3.14. |
| Qiskit | `>=2.5.2,<3.0.0` | Circuits, transpilation and the test oracles. This is the line that Qollab adds by itself. |
| qiskit-ionq | `>=1.0.0,<2.0.0` | The IonQ native gates and the IonQ backend. |
| NumPy | `>=2.0,<3.0` | The statevector and the gate matrices. |
| Quarto | 1.4 or newer | Only for building this book. |

The Python packages are declared in `pyproject.toml`. The same packages, without
the development tools, are declared in `requirements.txt` for Qollab, and a test
checks that the two lists are equal.

### The versions that were tested {.unnumbered}

Qollab ships its own `qiskit-ionq`, and the version is not documented. The
library does not use a function that only the newest versions have, so any
version from 1.0.0 works. The whole test suite was run with each of the following.

| qiskit-ionq | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.0, 1.0.1, 1.0.2 | Everything works, except the tomography on a backend that is not IonQ. The native gates of these versions have no definition, so Qiskit cannot transpile them. The tomography then raises a `TranspilationError` that says so. |
| 1.0.3, 1.1.0, 1.1.1 | Everything works. |

Qiskit 2.5.2 and NumPy 2.4.6 (and NumPy 2.0.2 with `qiskit-ionq` 1.0.0) were used.
On Qollab, the page of the test project prints the versions that are really
installed (see `documentation/prompts/qollab_pruebas.md`).

### What Qollab installs {.unnumbered}

The rules of the platform for `requirements.txt` are the following (see the
[runtime environment](https://qollab.xyz/learn/docs/runtime-environment) page of
Qollab).

- One package per line, as `name==1.2.3` or as a range. Comments and blank lines
  are allowed.
- Pip options, environment markers and URL requirements are rejected.
- Qiskit is always installed. When the file does not name it, Qollab adds
  `qiskit>=2.5.2,<3.0.0`; when it does, the line is used as written. The line of
  this project is the same as the default.
- The packages that Pyodide has built (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib) load when they
  are imported. A pure-Python wheel from PyPI is installed.
- A package that needs compiled code, and has no Pyodide build, stops the run with
  `no installable distribution for '<name>'`.
- Qollab has no `qiskit-ionq` in its documentation, but the IonQ backends are
  built with it. This is why its range does not ask for a newer version than the
  platform has: a range that the installed version satisfies leaves it as it is.

## Installing the library {.unnumbered}

A virtual environment is created and the package is installed in editable mode.
The commands are run from the project root.

```bash
make venv          # creates the .venv directory
make install       # installs the package with its development extras
```

The `make install` command runs `pip install -e ".[dev]"`. The development
extras are `pytest`, `jsonschema`, `flake8` and `pydocstyle`.

The same steps can be done by hand:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Checking the installation {.unnumbered}

```bash
make test          # runs the test suite with pytest
make lint          # runs flake8 and pydocstyle
```

If both commands finish without an error, the installation is correct.

## Building this book {.unnumbered}

The book is a Quarto project. It is configured by `_quarto.yml` in the project
root. The following commands are available.

```bash
make -f Makefile.quarto render       # builds the HTML book into _book/
make -f Makefile.quarto preview      # live preview on http://localhost:4321
make -f Makefile.quarto pdf-typst    # builds a PDF with Typst
make -f Makefile.quarto clean        # removes the build output
```

The output is written to the `_book` directory. This directory is not committed.
